enumeration_method: The vendor sitemap index https://www.flowable.com/sitemap.xml lists four sub-sitemaps, all walked in full: (1) https://documentation.flowable.com/latest/sitemap.xml - 730 urls (enterprise docs: reactmodel 371, develop 111, user 91, admin 66, howto 52, ai 19, cloud 9, walkthroughs 5, misc 7); (2) https://www.flowable.com/3x-sitemap.xml - 465 urls (marketing: blog 331, events 28, success-stories 21, jobs 14, solutions 11, resources 7, partners 5, product 3, company 3, misc 42); (3) https://www.flowable.com/open-source/docs/sitemap.xml - 43 urls (open-source manual); (4) https://www.flowfest.flowable.com/sitemap.xml - 2 urls. Added by hand from the same host: https://training.flowable.com/sitemap.xml - 121 urls. Nothing was keyword-filtered: every url in every sitemap is a frontier line and a ledger row. No url appeared in two sitemaps (0 duplicates).
note: VISUAL-CHANNEL LIMITATION, read this before reviewing any verdict. This session cannot receive image content: Read on a PNG returns an empty result, verified on a 400x120 synthetic test image, on a 36-cell contact sheet, and through a subagent on a vision-capable model reading the same file. take_screenshot writes the file to disk but no pixels reach the model. The pilot rule "look at every candidate diagram yourself" therefore could not be executed as written. Substitute channel, approved by the orchestrator: every candidate figure asset was downloaded at native resolution and OCR-ed locally (RapidOCR, offline), so the labels drawn inside each figure are available as text; those labels are quoted in the records and count as evidence. OCR cannot certify notation (BPMN vs CMMN vs DMN vs UI screenshot) from shapes, so: a figure whose OCR shows AI-ish labels is UNCERTAIN + needs_visual_check unless prose/DOM/xml already certifies BPMN; a figure whose OCR returned nothing legible is never an exclusion ground; every row whose verdict rests on a figure that OCR could not certify is listed in ledgers/flowable.raw/visual-queue.json for a sighted pass. Enumeration facts: 1361 unique urls, 1361 rows, one ledger row per frontier line, no url judged from a listing snippet. 85 frontier urls answer HTTP 404 from the vendor sitemap itself (dead links, E0-no-artefact, mechanical). Page text, <pre> blocks naming BPMN constructs, downloadable .bpmn/.dmn/.cmmn/.zip targets, img/srcset/srcset-largest and CSS background images were captured for all 1361 urls into ledgers/flowable.raw/scan.json.
